Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring expiration of enactments of the legislature with fiscal impacts unless funding is provided.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to expiration of enactments of the legislature withfiscal impacts; and adding a new section to chapter 43.135 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.135 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any enactment of the legislature with a fiscal note indicating afiscal impact greater than zero dollars shall expire no later than oneyear after the earliest effective date applicable to any section of theenactment, unless specific funding for the purposes of the enactment,referencing the enactment by bill or chapter number, is provided in anappropriation that takes effect before the enactment expires.
